name: mailmypdf
description: Create, review, securely process, and mail document workflows through MailMyPDF.

interface.shortDescription: Create and mail PDFs from chat
interface.longDescription: Use MailMyPDF to turn notices, appeals, disputes, records requests, claims, and other document problems into secure matters, reviewable drafts and packets, hosted checkout, physical mailing, tracking, and proof.
defaultPrompt: Help me respond to this attached notice and prepare a reviewable mailing packet.
Create a MailMyPDF workflow from these facts and show me the exact packet before approval.
Check whether my MailMyPDF order was mailed and show any available tracking.
